title.value: PhAST: Physics-Aware, Scalable, and Task-Specific GNNs for Accelerated Catalyst Design
title.justification: The title clearly describes the focus of the paper on GNNs and their application in catalyst design for improvements in physics awareness and scalability, which is tied to accelerated processes necessary for advancing catalyst design.
title.quote: PhAST: Physics-Aware, Scalable, and Task-Specific GNNs for Accelerated Catalyst Design

extractions.description: The paper presents PhAST, a framework of architectural innovations for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) that are physics-aware and scalable, aimed at accelerating the design of catalysts used in low-carbon energy processes. PhAST enhances computational efficiency and accuracy in catalyst discovery, key to climate change mitigation via improved electrocatalysts needed for energy storage and industrial processes like fertiliser and cement production.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly connects the proposed advancements in catalyst design to climate change mitigation, emphasizing the role of efficient catalysts in reducing carbon emissions in various industrial processes.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Mitigating the climate crisis requires a rapid transition towards lower-carbon energy. Catalyst materials play a crucial role in the electrochemical reactions involved in numerous industrial processes key to this transition, such as renewable energy storage and electrofuel synthesis.
